title: Mitchell Berman
intro:
Mitchell Berman (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Wisconsin's 1st Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
Berman completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
